[EN] The Long and Winding Ode
[ES] La larga y sinuosa oda
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The acolytes will teach you the rest.
[ES] Los acólitos te enseñarán el resto.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Can you remember? You can remember, can't you?
[ES] ¿Puedes recordarlo? Puedes recordarlo, ¿verdad?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I can remember that."
[ES] "Puedo recordar eso."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I've got it."
[ES] "Lo tengo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk with the acolytes in the Bower who hold the key to the Goddess's Garden.
[ES] Habla con los acólitos en el Bower que tienen la llave del Jardín de la Diosa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Then let's go!"
[ES] "¡Entonces vamos!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return with the key to Anther at Camp Verdant.
[ES] Regresa con la llave a Anther en Camp Verdant.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
